Showcase · 2026-08-29 · @rtc/client-react-native vs docs/design/mobile/v1

How far the React Native client sits from the mobile-v1 prototype, screen by screen

Left column: the committed simctl golden at be6cea565 — the app, framed in its real HUD chrome since Phase 0 (PR #588) and, for the boot scenes, the real boot sequence since Phase 0b, rendered over a static fake ViewModel with motion frozen. Right column: the frozen prototype reference shot from the deviation corpus. Both are 1206×2622, the iPhone 17 logical viewport, so the panels are directly comparable. The prototype cannot change, so a difference is never a failure — it is a measure of how far the app has moved from the design, and where. Verdicts are an eyeball, not a pixel metric: a pixel diff between two different renderers of different sample data measures nothing.

Module screens, worst first

The ten surfaces the fidelity pass will work, in the order it should take them. Each card names what differs; deliberate additions are called out as such so they are not mistaken for drift.

01

lock/hold

Hold-to-unlock

Close
  • Rebuilt to the design's stack (2026-08-30): accent glow, the 58px hex emblem with its dashed orbit, SESSION LOCKED in Orbitron, an id · desk line, the 112px ring with the ⌖ crosshair, AUTHENTICATING… beneath it while an unlock is in flight.
  • The one addition the design lacks is the password field between the desk line and the ring — the ring here submits real credentials, so the field stays; it wears the tile idiom (1px border, radius 9, tracked mono placeholder). The design's line ends in a clock; the app's ends at the desk.
  • Deliberately unframed on both sides — the design's lock has no chrome either.

shell/appearance

Appearance sheet

Close
  • Rebuilt to the design (2026-08-30): a translucent, blurred sheet at 80% with the Rates grid showing through, APPEARANCE and the ☾ DARK · ☀ LIGHT pill on one row, tile-style skin cards with the design's 16-8-8 swatches and mono labels, a real 44×26 switch on the Ambient row, Replay Boot as a tracked mono outline.

Cross-cutting

Differences that appear in every framed pair rather than in one module — and two that look like drift but are not.

Typography
Fixed 2026-08-30: the three remaining face/case misses (Orbitron wordmark, the strip's MODULE value, the connection banner) — and a harness fix behind them: the visual host used to paint first-commit text before the bundled fonts loaded, so every earlier golden showed the system face where the device shows the bundled one. All goldens re-pinned.
Status strip clock
Frozen at 09:47:03 in the app column (a harness pin); the prototype shows a live time. Not drift.
Status bar and dynamic island
Real in the app column (pinned to 09:41, full bars, charged); absent in the prototype, whose bezel draws them outside the captured element. Not drift.

Boot scenes

All eight scene ports against their prototype originals — the real BootSequence in the app column, pinned at 60% of the ramp. The scenes are close; the chrome around them is the deviation, named once below because it is the same in every pair.

  • Scene compositions match one for one — the eight canvases are ports of the eight prototype scenes, and each pair shows the same geometry at a comparable instant.
  • The boot chrome now matches (2026-08-30): the design's bottom block — Orbitron wordmark, one mono line MOBILE OS // SEQ n/8 · SCENE NAME, a 2px single-hue rail, a ▸ boot log line — and SKIP ▸ as the bordered mono pill pinned bottom-right. The 60% readout and the two old subtitle lines are gone.
  • The scene's top telemetry now carries a safe-area inset, so on the device it clears the dynamic island the prototype's bezel never drew.
  • Each app frame is one pinned instant (elapsedSec = 2.52); the prototype shot is whichever instant the corpus captured. Timing differences are not drift.

How this was made. A Claude Code session composed each app golden beside its prototype shot with ImageMagick, read every pair, and wrote the verdicts and notes by hand; the thumbnails here are 300px, 256-colour reductions of the committed PNGs, inlined so the page is one file. It is a companion, not a source of truth: the generated pair table is docs/design/mobile/v1/reference-shots/DRIFT.md (pnpm prototype-shots:drift), the pending work is the "RN prototype-fidelity pass" entry in docs/STATUS.md, and the finding that the comparison had been measuring the harness rather than the app is T48 in docs/rn-open-items.md. Regenerate by re-running the session's builder against a newer golden set after each module phase lands — the verdicts are the part that has to be re-read, not re-run.
